bass.tags: Hard rock. Distorted electric guitar plays a repetitive, palm-muted riff centered on a low E pedal tone. The drum kit features a dry, punchy snare and a resonant kick drum playing a syncopated pattern that emphasizes the first and third beats. A distorted bass guitar doubles the guitar riff. The tempo is 120 BPM in 4/4 time. The guitar tone uses high gain with a mid-range boost.

[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[palm-muted distorted electric guitar riff]
[syncopated kick drum and snare enter]
[distorted bass guitar enters]

drums.tags: Hard rock drum solo. The performance features a high-fidelity acoustic drum kit with a resonant, punchy kick drum, a crisp snare with a bright crack, and multiple rack and floor toms. The drummer executes rapid-fire sixteenth-note fills across the toms and snare. The hi-hat is played partially open for a washier texture, while the ride cymbal is struck on the bell for a piercing, rhythmic accent. Frequent crash cymbal hits punctuate the phrases. The recording has a natural room reverb with a slight compression on the overheads. 120 BPM. 4/4 time signature.

[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[snare and hi-hat count-in]

[Main Section]
[driving kick drum, syncopated snare hits]
[rapid sixteenth-note tom fills]
[open hi-hat wash]
[ride cymbal bell accents]
[crash cymbal hits on downbeats]

vocals.tags: Hardcore punk with heavy thrash metal influence. Distorted electric guitars play fast, palm-muted down-strokes and rapid power chord transitions. The bass guitar follows the guitar riffs with a thick, overdriven tone. Drums feature a high-tempo d-beat pattern with a sharp, cracking snare and constant eighth-note hi-hat hits. Vocals are shouted in a rhythmic, aggressive hardcore style with high-pitched screams layered in the background. The recording has a raw, lo-fi aesthetic with minimal stereo separation. Tempo is 185 BPM in the key of E minor.
